_comment: The stage-3 arms, defined ONCE so the output directory and the threshold
source can never disagree. Every consumer -- stage3_state.py,
stage3_worker.sh, run_stage3.sbatch, preflight_stage3.sh -- reads this file
rather than carrying its own copy of the mapping.
Why that matters: the two arms differ ONLY in an env var and a directory. If
an arm's directory and its override ever drift apart, the run completes, the
chain reports success, and the predictions are silently the wrong arm's --
the exact class of failure sec.6 calls out, where a wrong answer looks
entirely plausible. The worker asserts the pairing at lane start.
override=null means NO OMNIPRO_HIT_THRESHOLD may be set: the fitted arm must
reach its nine values through config.py's per-task lookup, the way a deployed
system does. A number means that flat global threshold is forced for every
task, which is what makes the global arm a single-degree-of-freedom control.
